title: Pan Fried Potatoes Pomme Friture
description: A simple and delicious recipe for crispy pan fried potatoes. This dish is perfect for a snack or side.
instructions: Heat 2 inches of friture in a large frying pan over medium-high heat.
Once the friture is hot, add the sliced potatoes and fry until golden brown.
Remove the fried potatoes from the pan and place on a paper towel lined plate.
Leave about 1 tablespoon of friture in the pan, then reduce heat to medium.
Add the sliced crunchy potatoes to the pan and fry until crispy.
Serve the pan fried potatoes hot and garnish with additional crispy potatoes if desired.
